english.title: Fail to provide business information to assess amount of levy on service of notice
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) failed to comply with a notice served on you by the Agriculture and Horticulture Development Board, requiring you to provide sufficient information within a time specified in that notice concerning a horticultural business operated by you, to enable the Board to assess whether a levy was payable and if so, the amount
english.legislation: Contrary to articles 6 and 16 of, and para 17(2) of part 4 of Schedule 3 to, the Agriculture and Horticulture Development Board Order 2008.

other.penalty:
Summary: A fine not exceeding level five on the standard scale.

Time Limit on Prosecutions
Complex - see article 16(2)

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
